name: input
description: Text input with error, disabled states and size variants; compose labeled or described inputs inside field-group so inner proximity and outer form rhythm have distinct owners

changes.note: Nested components keep their own parts. The stylesheet reached an input-group's prefix and suffix with descendant selectors, so a component nested inside with parts of the same name took this one's styles. Both are the group's children, and the padding rules that make room for them ask :has(> prefix) / :has(> suffix). Every part rule is now a child chain from the root, with the hops in :where(), so no rule changes specificity. No change for markup that follows the template.
The labeled reference now composes field-group, which keeps label/control/help text on the tight density-aware inner step while the surrounding default rhythm spaces adjacent fields.

data-width='fixed' is now declared (it was in the CSS but in no manifest) and its responsive rule is mobile-first on the breakpoint canon: the 250px cap applies from sm (40rem) up instead of being undone below 640px. Same two widths at the same threshold; the boundary itself moves to the wide side, so at exactly 640px the input is now capped rather than full-bleed.

prefix.description: Leading icon or text inside input-group

suffix.description: Trailing icon or text inside input-group

width.description: data-width='fixed' caps the input at 250px from the sm tier (40rem) up; below sm it is full-bleed. Unset, the input fills its container at every width.
